articles.title: China Completes Mengzhou Abort Test, Splashes Down Booster
articles.summary: On Wednesday, February 11th, the China Manned Space Agency conducted an in-flight abort test of their Mengzhou crewed lunar spacecraft, launched atop a Long March 10A test booster.
